item.title: Hurricane Lala skirts Hawaii’s Big Island without making landfall as heavy wind, rain lash region
item.description: Hurricane Lala has skirted Hawaii’s Big Island without making landfall and is expected to weaken after lashing the region with strong winds and drenching rain.
